reviewerIndependence: Each reviewer receives only the same arm-blind packet and completes all criteria without access to the label mapping or the other review.
passRule: All four semantic criteria must pass.
paraphraseRule: Accurate semantic equivalents pass; literal regex phrasing is not required.
disagreementRule: Any criterion disagreement remains unresolved until a third arm-blind review of that item. No unresolved item counts as correct.
unblindingRule: Arm labels are joined only after both complete review files validate and consensus is computed.
reportingRule: Report frozen automatic correctness and secondary semantic correctness separately, including disagreement counts and protocol timing.
